Class TextureDefinition

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.texture.TextureDefinition
public final class TextureDefinition extends Object
Immutable description of a procedural terrain texture loaded from textures.xml.

Definitions are created by the package's XML loader and consumed by ProceduralTextureGenerator.
